posts.heading: October 5, 2026
posts.text:
October 5 saw 206 feeder visits and 19 species recorded, down from the past week’s averages of 319 visits and 21.4 species. The Eastern Towhee, Northern Cardinal, and Carolina Chickadee remained consistent, each appearing on every day of the last week.

A single probable sighting of a Gray Catbird was noted, a species observed on six of the last seven days. The Eastern Towhee’s high detection count, led by 16 detections in the 09:00 hour, continued its pattern as the most frequently heard species. Northern Cardinal sightings occurred near both sunrise and sunset, maintaining the species' consistent presence throughout the week.
